records.title: Behemoth: A Flash-centric Training Accelerator for Extreme-scale DNNs
records.reason: Behemoth pairs a training accelerator with a NAND-flash memory system to train extreme-scale DNNs, reporting training throughput and cost versus TPU v3; training-only hardware with no inference application.

records.title: Unstructured Pruning and Low Rank Factorisation of Self-Supervised Pre-Trained Speech Models
records.reason: Applies unstructured pruning plus low-rank factorization (via truncated SVD) to self-supervised speech models to cut memory and compute; compression is generic, but the target is speech-task models, not LLM inference.

records.title: CrisPrune: Combining Contextual Relevance and Intrinsic Saliency for Efficient Visual Token Pruning in MLLMs
records.reason: CrisPrune is a training-free visual token pruning method for MLLMs combining intrinsic visual saliency with contextual relevance to relieve the multimodal inference bottleneck; direct inference-time token pruning.

records.title: AssoMem: Scalable Memory QA with Multi-Signal Associative Retrieval
records.reason: AssoMem builds an associative memory graph with multi-signal retrieval for large-scale memory question answering; a memory-retrieval framework for assistants, not an inference execution or serving technique.

records.title: Bilinear Input Modulation for Mamba: Koopman Bilinear Forms for Memory Retention and Multiplicative Computation
records.reason: Bilinear Input Modulation augments Mamba SSMs with a state-input product (Koopman form) with parallel-scan-compatible variants; an architecture improvement for sequence modeling, not an inference system contribution.

records.title: LCT: Losslessly Compressed Tensors with GPU friendly execution for Training
records.reason: Losslessly Compressed Tensors compress weights, activations and optimizer states with GPU Huffman kernels to save memory during training and fine-tuning; training-only memory reduction with no inference use stated.

records.title: Efficient and Generalizable Speaker Diarization via Structured Pruning of Self-Supervised Models
records.reason: Structured pruning guided by distillation compresses WavLM-based speaker diarization models (80% smaller, 4x faster inference); the compression method is sound but the application is a speech diarization model, not LLM inference.

records.title: Learning distributed representations with efficient SoftMax normalization
records.reason: Proposes a linear-time heuristic for SoftMax normalization constants when learning distributed embeddings; a representation-learning algorithm, not an inference-system technique.

records.title: Enhancing depression detection in social media through BERT model pruning
records.reason: Introduces an attention-head-importance pruning strategy for BERT aimed at edge deployment, but the work is framed and evaluated as depression detection on social media; application-led with a compression component.

records.title: MMDuet2: Enhancing Proactive Interaction of Video MLLMs with Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: MMDuet2 uses multi-turn RL to make video MLLMs proactively decide when to reply during playback; an interaction-capability method with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: An Empirical Study of Harness Design for Coding Agents
records.reason: Empirically varies coding-agent harness components (planning, action space, context management) on SWE-Bench; an agent-design study, not an inference system technique.

records.title: Towards Universal Video MLLMs with Attribute-Structured and Quality-Verified Instructions
records.reason: Builds ASID-1M structured audiovisual instruction data and a verification pipeline for universal video MLLMs; dataset/curation work with no inference-system content.

records.title: TIDAL: Temporally Interleaved Diffusion and Action Loop for High-Frequency VLA Control
records.reason: TIDAL is a dual-frequency scheduler that caches semantic embeddings and interleaves diffusion planning with high-frequency VLA actuation to cut control latency; inference scheduling, but for a robotics control application.

records.title: Scaling Laws for Collapse in Asynchronous GRPO
records.reason: Derives scaling laws linking policy staleness and learning rate to collapse in asynchronous GRPO post-training; training-stability analysis with no inference application.

records.title: FocusGraph: Graph-Structured Frame Selection for Embodied Long Video Question Answering
records.reason: FocusGraph selects informative keyframes via scene-graph captions to make embodied long-video QA faster and lighter; frame selection reduces MLLM input cost, but the work targets a QA application.

records.title: Latent Preference Modeling for Cross-Session Personalized Tool Calling
records.reason: MPT benchmarks cross-session personalized tool calling and PRefine maintains latent user preferences as test-time memory; agent memory/personalization work, not an inference system technique.

records.title: VideoSeeker: Incentivizing Instance-level Video Understanding via Native Agentic Tool Invocation
records.reason: VideoSeeker enables instance-level spatiotemporal video understanding via native agentic tool invocation; a perception-capability paradigm with no inference efficiency contribution.

records.title: ToolGen: Unified Tool Retrieval and Calling via Generation
records.reason: ToolGen represents each tool as a unique token so LLMs generate retrieval and calls within next-token prediction, avoiding separate retrieval; it changes the tool-use interface, with inference-system impact only indirect.

records.title: Not all tokens are needed(NAT): token efficient reinforcement learning
records.reason: NAT updates RL policies on a selected subset of generated tokens via Horvitz-Thompson reweighting to cut RL training cost; training efficiency only, with no inference application.

records.title: VeriPhy: Agentic Physical Reasoning for World Model Evaluation and Refinement
records.reason: VeriPhy verifies physical obligations in generated videos with typed measurements and frozen experts; a world-model evaluation/refinement system, not LLM inference.
